create_NougatImageProcessorPil: create a NougatImageProcessorPil instance to preprocess images for the Nougat model
run_preprocess_images: run preprocess on a batch of images with margin cropping, resizing, thumbnail, padding, rescaling, and normalization
crop_margin_image: crop gray margins from an image using a configurable gray threshold
align_long_axis_image: rotate an image by 90 degrees so its long axis matches the target size's long axis
resize_thumbnail_image: resize an image to thumbnail dimensions preserving aspect ratio within target bounds
